selection: All 14 fixed pilot IDs are included in offline fitting; runtime IDs must be explicitly selected. Diagnostic cases are exploratory, not an independent held-out sample.
runtime_order: Alternate legacy-first and exact-first by original pilot position; one request per variant; saved calls include load and prompt durations.
accuracy: No automated correctness labels or architecture ranking; run outputs require separate rubric assessment.
budget: context_tokens - output_tokens - template_margin_tokens; exact counter includes verified runtime template; same context/output allowance and answer instruction for both variants.
